name: Back Up a Git Repository as a Bundle
description: Write a complete, single-file copy of a git repository with all its branches and tags using git bundle on a schedule, so a lost laptop or a force-pushed remote does not take the only copy of your history with it.

parameters.label: Repository path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the local git repository.

parameters.label: Bundle file path
parameters.help: Absolute path of the .bundle file to write, ideally on a different drive or a synced folder. It is overwritten on every run, so rotate it separately if you want history.
